root_cause: User trust cannot rely on an agent claiming that logging, documentation, learning and skill updates happened. Assurance must come from fail-closed repository/runtime controls and terminal evidence that can be read back independently of the chat.
prevention_rule: For every material Powerhouse execution routed through the canonical repository-backed delivery path, require Brain learning, append-only ledger evidence, human-readable documentation, semantic root-cause/prevention/evidence validation, automatic learning-to-skill projection, protected delivery and production/provider readback before terminal success. Treat any missing artifact or projection as WRITEBACK_INCOMPLETE or LEARNING_WRITTEN_SKILL_SYNC_PENDING, never LIVE_BEWEZEN.

outcome.truth_boundary: This verifies enforcement for material Powerhouse work that traverses the canonical repository-backed delivery/runtime path. It does not claim observability for arbitrary external actions that bypass that path.
